ns2:course.label: Space, Time, and Matter-ACP
ns2:course.description: Course is identical to PHYS 420 except for the additional writing component including a final term paper. Same as PHIL 419. 3 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours. Credit is not given for both PHYS 419 and PHYS 420. Junior standing is required. Prerequisite: One physical science course; one of PHYS 214, PHIL 101, PHIL 270, PHIL 317.
